facts.name: Sea Holly
facts.notes: Metallic blue thistle-like flowers in summer that bees adore and that dry well for bouquets. Wants sun and good drainage.

sources.title: University of Illinois Extension: Deer Resistant Perennials
sources.note: Lists Rattlesnake Master (Eryngium) as deer resistant, while Rutgers rates Eryngium D. Because the two disagree, Rattlesnake Master and Sea Holly are left unrated.

companions.why: Walters Gardens (Zeeland, Michigan) lists varieties of these as companions: Liatris and Coreopsis.
